title: The Crooked Tower
intro: On Halloween night you climbed to the top of the crooked tower, and the trapdoor slammed shut behind you. Three ghosts drift around the room. They used to live here, and they will let you go only when the great beacon on the tower is lit again, so lost souls can find their way.
winText: The beacon blazes over the crooked town, the three ghosts swirl around it and the trapdoor drops open. You climb down the spiral stairs into the misty night. Behind you a raven caws, with a silver spoon in its beak.

do.say: A twisting hill rises into the mist, with a little graveyard on top. Too far to make out the tombstones.

count.text: A little carved bat! {n} of {of} found.

do.say: With the fifth bat a panel in the wall clicks and swings open.

do.say: With the fifth bat a panel in the wall clicks and swings open.
A stern old lady in a lace bonnet. Under the frame: a brass plate with three studs.
A thin gentleman in a tall top hat. Under the frame: a brass plate with one stud.
A sleepy boy in a striped nightcap. Under the frame: a brass plate with two studs.

hotspots.label: Cabinet lock
hotspots.hint: Each ghost carries a number, but only in the dark. The portraits tell you whose number comes first.

do.say: Cobwebs and an empty jam jar.

hotspots.label: Bat carving
hotspots.hint: Little bats are carved all over the room. Find all five.

do.say: A wooden panel with a big carved bat. Next to it, five little empty bat shapes, as if waiting for something.
A round glass lens in a brass ring.
An empty hollow behind the panel.
You blow the candle out. In the dark the ghosts glow brighter, and something shows on their chests.

hotspots.label: Candle
hotspots.fail: The candle is out. You need something to light it again.

do.say: The candle flickers back to life.
Nobody needs the candle now: the beacon lights everything.

hotspots.label: Organ keys
hotspots.hint: The keys carry the same signs as something far away. You need a closer look at it first.

do.say: Six keys, each with a little sign: a skull, a moon, a bat, a pumpkin, a cat and a spider. Pressing them at random only makes the organ wheeze. Somewhere there must be a hint which ones to play.

hotspots.label: Organ keys
hotspots.hint: The keys carry the same signs as something far away. Look closer.

do.say: The organ wheezes a happy little tune.

hotspots.label: Telescope
hotspots.fail: A brass telescope pointed at the hill. The front lens is missing.
hotspots.hint: The telescope needs its lens. The bats know where it is.

do.say: The lens clicks in. Through the telescope you see the graveyard on the hill: four tombstones, each with a carved sign.

hotspots.label: Raven
hotspots.fail: A big black raven with a beacon wick in its beak. It tilts its head and eyes your pockets. Ravens love shiny things.
hotspots.hint: The raven will trade the wick for something shiny.

do.say: The raven drops the wick and snatches the silver spoon. A fair trade.
The raven admires its spoon.

hotspots.label: Beacon
hotspots.fail: A great iron lantern with an empty wick holder.
hotspots.hint: The beacon has no wick. Someone with feathers took it.

do.say: The wick fits snugly in the holder.

hotspots.label: Beacon
hotspots.fail: The wick is in. Now it needs a flame.
hotspots.hint: You need a flame for the wick.

do.say: The beacon roars into light! The three ghosts swirl around it, and somewhere below a lock clicks.
The beacon blazes over the crooked town.
A heavy trapdoor. It is raised and lowered by the winch, and the winch has no handle.

hotspots.label: Winch
hotspots.fail: A winch with a square hole where its handle should be.
hotspots.hint: The winch needs a handle, and the ghosts must agree to let you go.

do.say: The handle fits, but the winch will not turn. Something cold holds it still.
The winch turns easily now and the trapdoor drops open.

crank_a.name: Handle grip
crank_a.text: The wooden grip of a winch handle.

combine.text: The grip slides onto the iron arm. A winch handle!

crank_b.name: Iron arm
crank_b.text: A bent iron arm with a square end.

crank.name: Winch handle
crank.text: A winch handle, all in one piece.

lens.name: Lens
lens.text: A round glass lens in a brass ring.

matches.name: Matches
matches.text: A box of matches. A few left.

wick.name: Wick
wick.text: A thick wick for the beacon.

scope_view.name: Through the telescope
scope_view.text: Four tombstones, left to right: a moon, a cat, a spider, a bat.

do.say: The cabinet creaks open. Inside: the wooden grip of a handle and a shiny silver spoon.

count.text: The little bat carved on the door counts too: {n} of {of} found.

do.say: With the fifth bat a panel in the wall clicks and swings open.

organ.title: Organ
organ.prompt: Each key has a little sign.

do.say: A spooky chord, and a little drawer slides out of the organ: an iron arm and a box of matches.
